_comment: Example real-event seed. Point VL_SEED_PATH at a file like this to launch with real bins/teams/rewards and a clean slate (no demo users/deposits). Replace coordinates with the actual bin GPS locations. teams[].baselinePoints is an optional funded head-start so the bracket looks alive on day one (use 0 for a true cold start).
